name: Bijan
text: A fantastic call. I learned a huge amount of practical and valuable information. I now have a clear, structured plan towards my interviews.

name: Ca
text: I took multiple sessions with Rupesh and have consistently been impressed by his deep expertise in DevOps and the AWS cloud domain. His background in development provides a solid foundation that enhances his ability to explain complex concepts clearly and effectively.

name: Shiv
text: I had the opportunity to interview with Rupesh for the Senior Site Reliability Engineer role. The session was very engaging, he created a comfortable environment that allowed me to share my experiences openly.

name: Faiz
text: Rupesh was great to work with again; I'm glad I booked him for a second session! He familiarized me with crucial design principles and patterns. The exercises we went through highlighted areas I could improve on.

name: Nicholas
text: I really enjoyed my session with Rupesh. He was able to quickly understand my position in my career, provide a clear, outside perspective, and leave me with both concrete action items for the short-term and big questions to think about.

name: Abhishek
text: Rupesh is amazing! He has extensive knowledge in technology and really helped me think at a higher level. His coaching has given me a framework to answer questions with numbers and always aim to raise the bar.

name: Ann
text: This was my >2 times with Rupesh for mock interview! He holds a very high bar and treats each mock interview as seriously as if it were his own team's hiring process. The session was incredibly valuable!

name: Ricardo
text: Rupesh is great! He provided me with more information in one hour than I could ever get in weeks of research. I now have a 6 month roadmap to data engineering.

name: Muhammad
text: I had my first mock interview session with Rupesh, and it was extremely insightful. He quickly identified the areas I needed to focus on and tailored the session specifically for the Solution Architect role I'm targeting.

name: Aman
text: Rupesh is a wonderful and kind coach who helped me through a full session of understanding System Design fundamentals. Prior to our session, I was intimidated by the thoughts of my upcoming interview but Rupesh has given me a solid framework.

name: Andre
text: I had a prep session with Rupesh for my Amazon interview. His experience as an Amazon Solutions Architect shows in his coaching. Rupesh gave clear feedback on my technical answers and communication style.

name: Melvin
text: Rupesh was amazing to work with. As a beginning Solutions Architect, I was stuck in my career, and he provided guidance for sharpening my skills, demonstrating competence, building my brand. By the end, I had a 90-day step-by-step plan.

name: Vaughn
text: I had a great experience working with Rupesh! He helped me approach object-oriented design interview problems with structure, confidence, and competency. His patience stood out.

name: Michael
text: I recently had a coaching session with Rupesh and it was amazing. He has strong experience with interview structure and walked me through the parts that I would face in the interview process.

name: Shamir
text: I had my first mock interview session with Rupesh. He focused on exactly what I was looking for. He brings a ton of data engineering and interview experience. I highly recommend Rupesh for data engineering interview coaching.
